actions.label: Protect AAC access
actions.notes: Keep device powered, visible, and reachable.

actions.label: Prepare defibrillator
actions.notes: Readiness is not an indication to shock. No energy values in content.

actions.label: Assess borrowed circuit and adapter (F1)
actions.notes: Conditional backup only without full clinical rehearsal.

actions.label: Assign degraded suction battery to bedside reserve (F2)
actions.notes: Bedside reserve or transport — not both. Transport remains held.

actions.label: Assign paid support worker within non-medical boundaries (F6)
actions.notes: AAC and personal continuity only. Excludes airway, circuit, ventilation, suction.

actions.label: Correct external circuit loading
actions.notes: Does not replace the airway route.

actions.label: Replace airway route
actions.notes: Locked during H5 emergency override without replacement indication.

bundles.label: G1 resource allocation (F1 + F2 + F6)
bundles.notes: Partial bundles allowed; duplicates confirm rather than double-apply.
